title: color_rgba validation tests the wrong `ok` — non-integer components silently load as 0
detail: `!ok` tests the outer `v.(json.Object)` binding (always true here), so the `okc` type check is dead. A non-integer color_rgba component silently loads as 0 (verified: ["red",1.5,112,255] loaded as [0,0,112,255], no error) — a silent default on malformed JSON, contra ODN-5.
recommended_fix: Change `!ok` to `!okc` so a non-integer color_rgba component fails fast with the existing named error.

title: Truncating u64/u8 casts run before the range guards — negative set-piece ticks wrap, lane 256 becomes 0
evidence:
sp.start_tick = u64(jint(seo, "start_tick", 0))
					sp.duration_ticks = u64(jint(seo, "duration_ticks", 0))
					sp.forecast_lead_ticks = u64(jint(seo, "forecast_lead_ticks", 0))
...
			pt.default_lane = u8(jint(eo, "default_lane", 1))
detail: Bound checks run after truncating casts: start_tick -5 loads as 18446744073709551611 (verified; the set-piece silently never fires — a negative duration never ends) and default_lane 256 loads as 0, slipping the duration==0 / lane>2 guards. Out-of-range values accepted, contra ODN-5.
recommended_fix: Validate the i32 values before widening: reject negative start_tick/duration_ticks/forecast_lead_ticks and default_lane outside 0..2 prior to the u64/u8 casts.

title: Duplicate demand era rows silently last-wins and leak the shadowed era's arrays
detail: A duplicate era row silently overwrites the earlier one (verified: two era:1 rows load, volume 9 last-wins, no error) and leaks the shadowed era's entries/set_pieces arrays — a duplicate content key should fail fast per ODN-5.
recommended_fix: Before `cat.demand.eras[era-1] = de`, reject a row whose era slot is already populated with a named duplicate-era error.
